title: Chaos Randomizer
description:
A Fabric mod that turns every Minecraft session into a chaotic randomizer! 
Complete random challenges under time pressure while surviving teleportations, random items, mob spawns, and more, then slay the Ender Dragon to win.
body:
**Chaos Randomizer** is a Fabric 1.21.1 mod that turns every Minecraft session into a randomizer full of chaos and objectives.

### **WARNING : Multiplayer for the mod is not supported yet. It's currently not really playable, even if you try. However, it will be added in the future with both Versus and Co-op modes.**

## How it works

Pick the number of challenges and a time limit. A roulette animation reveals your objectives — then the chaos begins. You must complete all your challenges before the timer expires, then defeat the Ender Dragon to win.

Random events fire every few seconds: teleportation, random items, potion effects, mob spawns, lightning, time and weather changes, and more.

## Features

- **40+ challenge types** — kill mobs, mine blocks, reach XP levels, wear full armor sets, get rare items, sleep nights, and more
- **Chaos events** every configurable interval (default: every 10 seconds)
- **Countdown timer** with a game over screen when time expires
- **Speedrun timer** to track your best runs — saved through crashes and reconnections
- **Roulette animation** when challenges are assigned
- **Re-roll system** (up to 3 times) before starting
- **Custom music** — drop `.ogg` files in `config/chaos_randomizer/music/` and they play as background music
- **Bilingual** — English and French, auto-detected from your Minecraft language setting

*Made by Wenjah & Claude (AI)*
